description: This file defines a web server component for the Focalboard project, including server setup, route registration, and TLS support.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Manages the HTTP web server, including route registration, TLS support, and server lifecycle.

methods.name: NewServer
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the web server with specified configuration.

methods.name: AddRoutes
methods.description: Registers a service's routes with the web server router.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the web server, with support for HTTP and HTTPS based on configuration.

methods.name: Router
methods.description: Returns the router associated with the server.
